lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition In6Bi6O12 (reduced formula InBiO2) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Bi centers in octahedral environments coordinated by six O neighbors and In centers in tetrahedral environments coordinated by four O neighbors. O atoms have three geometric neighbors, two Bi and one In. The analysis finds corner-sharing between In tetrahedra and Bi octahedra, as well as edge-sharing between Bi octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
